prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML file (Tailwind v4 browser CDN + Lucide) for the main dashboard screen of "Nutrio", a SaaS admin for a nutrition clinic in Amman: sidebar with navigation, header, page toolbar, 4 KPI cards, one chart, appointments table with status badges and row actions, activity list; dark mode and RTL toggles as a plus; realistic Arabic-Jordanian names; no commercial template code.

assertions.name: tokens-not-raw-palette
assertions.text: Colours come from semantic CSS variables/roles; the lint finds no raw Tailwind palette classes (bg-blue-500, text-gray-600 …) in component markup.

assertions.name: deliberate-personality
assertions.text: The page does not use the default-AI look: not Inter-only typography with a blue-600 primary on zinc greys; a display/text pairing or a non-default primary hue is chosen on purpose and stated in notes.

assertions.name: dark-mode-class
assertions.text: Dark mode is implemented as a class on <html> (not only a media query) with a working toggle and persisted preference.

assertions.name: rtl-logical-properties
assertions.text: Layout uses logical utilities (ps-/pe-/ms-/me-/start-/end-) so dir=rtl mirrors the shell; directional icons are mirrored.

assertions.name: table-states-and-actions
assertions.text: The appointments table has status badges with text (not colour alone) and row actions; at least a loading/skeleton or empty state exists for the table.

assertions.name: control-sizing-consistency
assertions.text: Buttons, inputs and selects share consistent heights (e.g. 28/34/40px scale) so mixed toolbar rows align.

assertions.name: one-primary-per-view
assertions.text: Exactly one solid primary action button is visible in the toolbar/header; other actions are outline/ghost.

assertions.name: keyboard-and-focus
assertions.text: Interactive elements are real buttons/links with visible focus styles; Esc closes any overlay; a search shortcut (Ctrl/⌘+K) is wired if a search exists.
